skill_yaml:
skill: push_to_goal
phases:
- id: align_1
  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
- id: align_2
  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
- id: pull_1
  type: pull
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance

skill: push_to_goal
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_above
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.08
  weight: 0.3
- id: contact_object
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.025
  weight: 0.3
- id: push_to_goal
  target_entity: object
  metric: goal_progress
  weight: 0.4
phases:
- id: approach
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.1
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.15
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_above
- id: descend
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.025
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    contact_z:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.04
      default: 0.025
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: contact_object
- id: push
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.2
      axis: task_goal_direction
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: positive
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.4
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.5
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: force_limit
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 25.0
    on_failure: abort
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: reduce_speed
  subtask_id: push_to_goal

skill: push_to_goal
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: pre_push
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.05
  weight: 0.3
- id: reach_goal
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    tolerance: 0.02
  parameters:
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.5
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: pre_push
- id: descend
  type: contact
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: force_threshold_switch
  termination: force_exceeded
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
  parameters:
    contact_force:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 1.0
      - 15.0
      default: 5.0
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.force_threshold

      type: scalar

      - 0.1
      default: 0.02
      binds_to:

    when: during_phase
    predicate: contact_detected
    threshold: 1.0
    on_failure: continue
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.01
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: pre_push
- id: push
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.15
      axis: task_goal_direction
      mode: replace_offset_projection
      sign: positive
    tolerance: 0.02
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.35
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.15
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: force_limit
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 25.0
    on_failure: abort
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.01
    - -0.01
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: reach_goal
